verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Linear runs cloud coding sessions for its agent (linear-docs-44, linear-docs-21). The changelog also says users can "restore to any previous checkpoint from version history" (linear-docs-35). However, that line sits next to agent text editing and Loops for documents (linear-docs-34), so it may refer to document versions rather than coding-agent sessions. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that checkpoints apply to coding agent sessions, details of how restore works for code and session state, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
